title: Yakima RoadShower 15L Complete Shower & Hose Bundle
breadcrumbs: Yakima RoadShower 15L Complete Shower & Hose Bundle
long_description: The Yakima RoadShower 15L Complete Shower & Hose Bundle takes the versatility of the RoadShower to the next level, creating an all-in-one pressurised water system ready for both showering and cleaning. At the heart of the bundle is the Yakima RoadShower 15L Small (8004109), a roof rack-mounted pressurised water tank constructed from welded aluminium with a durable powder-coated finish. The tank features two water outlet ports – one positioned at each end – allowing you to configure your water setup to suit your adventure. This bundle takes advantage of both outlets. By adding the included second Yakima RoadShower On-Off Elbow (8004103), you can have a dedicated accessory connected at either end of the RoadShower. Yakima specifically designed the additional elbow to activate the second 1/2" outlet port and make it easier to run multiple RoadShower accessories. Set one end up with the 214cm Extra Long Hose for rinsing: muddy bikes, dirty camping gear, sandy feet, pets, wetsuits and water sports equipment, campsite dishes, recovery equipment, general outdoor gear. Then leave the 76cm FlexHead Shower connected at the opposite end, giving you a dedicated shower whenever it's time to wash off after a day on the tracks, trails or beach. The result is a much more convenient RoadShower setup. Instead of disconnecting the hose every time you want to attach the shower head, both accessories can remain installed and ready for use. The 214cm Extra Long Hose provides substantially more reach around the vehicle and connects to the On-Off Elbow using quick-connect hardware. This makes it ideal for washing larger equipment or reaching muddy bikes and gear without having to position everything immediately beside the vehicle. At the other end, the 76cm FlexHead Shower features a flexible neck and variable shower head, turning the RoadShower into a convenient outdoor shower for camping, touring and remote adventures. It also connects directly to the On-Off Elbow using quick-connect hardware. The RoadShower itself can be pressurised through its Schrader air valve using a hand or electric pump. Its built-in pressure relief valve automatically limits pressure to a maximum of 65psi, providing a useful pressurised water supply even when you're well away from mains water. During the day, the black aluminium tank naturally absorbs heat from the sun, helping warm the stored water for a more comfortable shower later at camp. A stick-on thermometer strip lets you check the tank temperature before use. The RoadShower mounts securely to compatible roof racks using stainless steel universal mounting hardware and includes SKS Locks to help secure the unit to the vehicle. Whether you're washing the mud from your mountain bike, rinsing sand from your feet, cleaning the dog or having a shower at the end of the day, this bundle gives you a dedicated hose and dedicated shower setup in one complete system. Bundle Includes: 1 x Yakima RoadShower 15L Small – 8004109; 1 x Yakima RoadShower On-Off Elbow – 8004103; 1 x Yakima RoadShower Extra Long Hose 214cm – 8881251; 1 x Yakima RoadShower FlexHead Shower Large 76cm – 8004106. Specifications & Features: Water capacity 15L; welded aluminium tank construction; durable powder-coated finish; two water outlet ports – one at each end; dual On-Off Elbow configuration; 214cm Extra Long Hose; 76cm FlexHead Shower; quick-connect accessory fittings; flexible shower neck with variable shower head; Schrader valve for pressurisation; maximum pressure 65psi; built-in pressure relief valve; solar-heated water capability; external thermometer strip; stainless steel universal roof rack mounting hardware; SKS Locks included with RoadShower; RoadShower empty weight 9.21kg; RoadShower weight with 15L water approximately 24kg.
micro_value_props: Dual outlet setup keeps the shower and cleaning hose connected at the same time
214cm extra-long hose makes rinsing bikes, gear, pets and campsite equipment easy
76cm FlexHead Shower provides a dedicated outdoor shower whenever you need it

gold_guarantee_content: Standard Rack Guarantee — Fit confidence, always free. Our Standard Rack Guarantee comes automatically with every roof rack purchase. It ensures your rack fits your vehicle and performs as it should — giving you confidence from day one. Gold Rack Guarantee — Book fitting, get total confidence. When you book your roof racks to be professionally fitted at Roof Racks Galore, you're automatically covered by our Gold Rack Guarantee — the most comprehensive protection for your gear and your journey. Gold Rack Guarantee includes: Professional Installation — enjoy complete confidence with a professional fit by our experienced Fit Technicians; with over 30 stores across Australia and New Zealand, we ensure your setup is correct, secure and safe for the long haul, whether you're carrying bikes, boxes, awnings or kayaks. Rack Check — Yearly Peace of Mind — a full safety check at time of install, plus Annual Rack Health Checks in Year 2 and Year 3, so you can travel with peace of mind, year after year. Key Cover — 3 Years of Nationwide Support — lost your rack keys on the road? Your Gold Guarantee includes Key Cover for 3 years, with up to 2 replacement keys per year. Free Basic Accessory Fitting — when your racks are fitted by us, we'll also fit your eligible accessories for free: roof boxes, roof-mounted bike racks, cargo baskets, kayak carriers, fishing rod holders, ski carriers, platform accessories (eye bolts, load stops, shovel holders, jerry can holders). Rooftop tents, awnings, ladder slide systems and other technical accessories are excluded; all items must be on the same invoice and fitted at the same time as the roof racks. 90-Day Exchanges and Hassle-Free Returns — covered for up to 90 days to exchange your racks if they're not the perfect fit for your needs, at any of our locations across Australia and New Zealand. Nationwide Support, Expert Advice — with over 30 stores across Australia and New Zealand, our team is here to help every step of the way. Note: Fitting charges apply and will be confirmed in-store before installation.
